```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # also attaches ggplot2, dplyr, readr, etc.
```

```{r build-od-parquet}
# The raw OD CSVs are far larger than memory (bus: ~18 GB in total), so we do
# not load them all at once. Instead, every monthly CSV in data/raw/OD/ is
# converted once into a Parquet dataset in data/processed/od_parquet/
# (about 8x smaller on disk). Months already converted are skipped, so this
# chunk is slow only the first time and after new months are downloaded.
build_od_parquet()

od <- open_od() # lazy: nothing is read into memory yet
od
```

```{r load-od-2021}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfT21 <- c(202103, 202106, 202109, 202112)

od_train_2021 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% dfT21) |>
  collect()
```

```{r load-od-2022}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
```

```{r}
months_sel <- c(dfT21, dfT22, dfT23)

od_train_21_23 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% months_sel) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    YEAR  = YYYYMM %/% 100L,
    MONTH = YYYYMM %% 100L,
    period = case_when(
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "AM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(17, 18, 19, 20) ~ "PM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY"                                     ~ "Weekday off-peak",
      TRUE                                                      ~ "Weekend/holiday"
    )
  )

od_train_21_23 <- od_train_21_23 %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DESTINATION_PT_CODE) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS), .groups = "drop")

od_train_21_23 %>% count(YEAR, MONTH, period)
```

```{r read spatial data}
read_sf(
  here('data', 'raw', 'spatial', 'MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson')
  ) -> m_subzone

read_sf(
  here('data', 'raw', 'spatial', 'LTAMRTStationExitGEOJSON.geojson')
  ) -> m_exit

read_csv(
  here('data', 'raw', 'train_station_codes_2026.csv')
  ) -> station_lookup
```

```{r lookup station code}
station_lookup <- station_lookup %>%
  transmute(
    stn_code = str_to_upper(str_squish(stn_code)),
    station_name = str_to_upper(str_squish(mrt_station_english))
  ) %>%
  distinct(stn_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r relate code to station name}
tibble(pt_code = unique(c(od_train_21_23$ORIGIN_PT_CODE,
                          od_train_21_23$DESTINATION_PT_CODE))) %>%
  mutate(code1 = str_split_i(pt_code, "[/-]", 1),    # "EW24/NS1" as "EW24"
         code2 = str_split_i(pt_code, "[/-]", 2)) %>%  # singal code as NA
  left_join(station_lookup %>% rename(name1 = station_name),
            by = c("code1" = "stn_code")) %>%
  left_join(station_lookup %>% rename(name2 = station_name),
            by = c("code2" = "stn_code"), na_matches = "never") %>%
  mutate(station_name = coalesce(name1, name2)) %>%   #recheck
  select(pt_code, station_name) -> code_lookup

code_lookup %>% filter(is.na(station_name))
```

```{r load area center}
area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")

area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )

area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")

area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")

m_subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_center)
```

```{r station to subzone}
m_exit %>%
  st_transform(3414) %>%
  mutate(station_name = str_to_upper(str_squish(STATION_NA)),
         station_name = str_remove(station_name, " (MRT|LRT) STATION$")) %>%
  group_by(station_name) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
  st_centroid() -> m_station

setdiff(code_lookup$station_name, m_station$station_name)

m_station %>%
  st_join(m_subzone %>% st_transform(3414) %>% select(SUBZONE_N),
          join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() -> station_sz

code_lookup %>%
  left_join(station_sz, by = "station_name") %>%
  select(pt_code, station_name, SUBZONE_N) -> code_sz

code_sz %>% filter(is.na(SUBZONE_N))
```

```{r define 4 centers}
code_sz <- code_sz %>%
  mutate(centre = case_when(
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_center    ~ "CBD",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong    ~ "Jurong Lake District",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands ~ "Woodlands",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines  ~ "Tampines",
    TRUE                          ~ "Other"
  ))

code_sz %>%
  filter(centre != "Other") %>%
  arrange(centre, station_name) %>%
  select(centre, station_name, SUBZONE_N)
```

```{r}
od_train_21_23 <- od_train_21_23 %>%
  left_join(code_sz %>% select(pt_code, origin_stn = station_name,
                               origin_sz = SUBZONE_N, origin_centre = centre),
            by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "pt_code")) %>%
  left_join(code_sz %>% select(pt_code, dest_stn = station_name,
                               dest_sz = SUBZONE_N, dest_centre = centre),
            by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "pt_code"))

sum(is.na(od_train_21_23$origin_centre))
sum(is.na(od_train_21_23$dest_centre))
```

```{r}
# Table 1: centre-to-centre flow matrix (including "Other")
# Shows where each centre's trips come from and go to, and how strongly
# each centre is linked to the CBD
od_train_21_23 %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, origin_centre, dest_centre) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") -> od_centre

# Table 2: flows from every station to each of the four centres
# Used for mapping each centre's catchment (which stations send trips to it)
od_train_21_23 %>%
  filter(dest_centre != "Other") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, dest_centre, origin_stn, origin_sz) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") -> od_station_to_centre

# Check: flows between centres, March 2023, AM peak
od_centre %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, MONTH == 3, period == "AM peak") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dest_centre, values_from = trips)
```

```{r three indicators}
centres <- c("CBD", "Jurong Lake District", "Woodlands", "Tampines")

# For each centre, sum inflow, outflow, internal trips and trips to the CBD
map(centres, function(cc) {
  od_centre %>%
    group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period) %>%
    summarise(
      centre   = cc,
      inflow   = sum(trips[dest_centre == cc & origin_centre != cc]),
      outflow  = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre != cc]),
      internal = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre == cc]),
      to_cbd   = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre == "CBD"]),
      total    = sum(trips),   # all trips island-wide
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  mutate(
    attraction        = inflow / total,
    cbd_outflow_share = if_else(centre == "CBD", NA_real_, to_cbd / outflow),
    in_out_ratio      = inflow / outflow
  ) -> indicators
```

```{r trip distance}
# Station coordinates (EPSG:3414, metres)
m_station %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
         y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(station_name, x, y) -> stn_xy

# Average straight-line distance of trips entering each centre from outside
od_train_21_23 %>%
  filter(dest_centre != "Other", origin_centre != dest_centre) %>%
  left_join(stn_xy %>% rename(ox = x, oy = y), by = c("origin_stn" = "station_name")) %>%
  left_join(stn_xy %>% rename(dx = x, dy = y), by = c("dest_stn" = "station_name")) %>%
  mutate(dist_km = sqrt((ox - dx)^2 + (oy - dy)^2) / 1000) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, centre = dest_centre) %>%
  summarise(mean_dist_km = weighted.mean(dist_km, trips, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") -> trip_distance

# Add distance to the indicator table
indicators <- indicators %>%
  left_join(trip_distance, by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "period", "centre"))

# Check: AM peak, March 2023
indicators %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, MONTH == 3, period == "AM peak") %>%
  select(centre, inflow, outflow, attraction, cbd_outflow_share, in_out_ratio, mean_dist_km)
```
